_comment: Copy to arc180.local.json and edit. That file is git-ignored — it holds every machine- and person-specific value, including the Supabase key. Never commit it.
_users_note: Exactly two. Each name must match a people/<name>/ folder in the knowledge base and the `user:` value in that machine's whoami file.
supabase_anon_key: <anon public key: Supabase dashboard -> Settings -> API>
_supabase_note: Optional. Leave both empty to run fully offline — the app then shows only this machine's side.
